shared_elements: shallow relief carving on rock surface
justification: A shows weathered natural boulders on a grassy slope with at most a faint possible incised motif and no legible imagery, while B is a densely carved stela with ordered horizontal registers of script signs and two kneeling/offering figures flanking a lower panel. There is no shared depicted subject, no comparable relationships and no comparable arrangement; the only commonality is that both surfaces are stone, which is excluded from consideration.
